title: Pip Sings!

Y·Z로 시작하는 단어 6개를 듣고 말하고 찾는다

story.title: Pip Sings!

panels.desc: A sunny meadow corner of the second garden. A shaggy brown yak with long horns licks strawberry yogurt out of a big cup, and a glowing golden seed is stuck on the yak's pink yogurt-covered nose. Bun points at the yak laughing; Hedgie holds the yogurt cup; Pip plays with a red yo-yo, the string wrapped around its wing. Hidden in the picture: the yak, the yogurt cup, the yo-yo. Far away on the hill path, Grumble is walking away from the garden alone with a little bundle on a stick over his shoulder, looking back over his shoulder with a sad frown; his lantern in his other paw shines very bright, like a star.
panels.ko: 야크가 요거트를 핥아요. 코에 씨앗이 붙었어요. 핍은 요요 놀이. 그럼블은 보따리를 메고 혼자 멀리 떠나요.

panels.desc: A black-and-white striped zebra stands on the path wearing a blue jacket with a metal zipper half open; a glowing golden seed peeks out of the jacket pocket. Hedgie tugs the zipper tab with both paws. Pip was trying to say a sound but has yawned and fallen fast asleep on the zebra's back with a tiny snore bubble. Bun giggles with a finger to her lips. Behind them the new Y letter tree with yogurt-, yak- and yo-yo-shaped fruits. Hidden in the picture: the zebra, the zipper. Grumble does NOT appear.

lines.text: The seed is in the zipper!

panels.ko: 얼룩말 재킷 지퍼 속에 씨앗이 있어요. 핍은 /z/ 소리를 내려다 하품하고 쿨쿨 잠들었어요.

panels.desc: A bold yellow zigzag path leads across the lawn to the very last empty clay pot at the end of the garden. Bun runs along the zigzag with the glowing seed held high; Hedgie follows; Pip, awake again, flies ahead. Twenty-five letter trees fill the background in neat rows like an orchard. Hidden in the picture: the zigzag path, the red yo-yo in Hedgie's paw. Grumble has come running back down the hill and stands right behind the friends panting, bundle dropped; his lantern shakes in his paw and glows so bright that its little door is rattling open.
panels.ko: 노란 지그재그 길 끝에 마지막 화분이 있어요. 번이 씨앗을 들고 달려요. 그럼블이 되돌아왔고 등불이 덜컹덜컹 열리려 해요.

panels.desc: The whole Sound Garden bursts into bloom: twenty-six letter trees covered in pink and white blossoms, petals drifting everywhere. Grumble's lantern has swung wide open and a single big glowing golden music note floats out of it and into Pip. Pip stands on the last pot with its beak wide open, singing for the first time, with little golden notes and sparkles streaming out. Bun and Hedgie hug each other with tears of joy. Grumble sits on the ground holding the open, now dazzlingly bright lantern in his lap, big tears rolling down his cheeks, but a tiny smile under them. Hidden in the picture: the glowing music note.
panels.ko: 스물여섯 그루가 꽃을 피웠어요! 등불에서 금빛 음표가 나와 핍에게 들어가요. 핍이 처음 노래해요. 그럼블은 눈물을 흘리며 살짝 웃어요.

ask.en: What comes out of the lantern?

story.synopsis_ko: 야크 코에 씨앗이, 얼룩말 지퍼 속에 씨앗이 있어요. 지그재그 길 끝 마지막 화분에 심자 스물여섯 그루가 꽃을 피웠어요! 그럼블의 등불이 열리며 노래 조각이 핍에게 들어가 핍이 처음으로 노래했어요. 그럼블은 울었어요.
story.so_far_ko: 화산이 터진 마을 구석에서 V·W·X 나무를 키웠어요. 그럼블의 등불이 별처럼 밝아졌어요.
story.goal_ko: 마지막 씨앗 둘을 찾아 Y·Z 나무를 키우고 스물여섯 그루를 완성해요.

videos.prompt: Gentle comic picture-book animation: the yak licks the yogurt and the seed on its nose twinkles, the baby bird's yo-yo goes up and down on its string, the rabbit laughs; far on the hill the raccoon walks away slowly and looks back. Camera still. Playful, child-friendly. No text.

Gentle picture-book animation: petals drift down over the blooming garden, the raccoon's lantern swings open and a glowing golden music note floats out and into the baby bird, the baby bird opens its beak and little golden notes stream out as it sings; the rabbit and the hedgehog hug; the raccoon wipes a tear. Camera still. Joyful, soft, child-friendly. No text.
